classification.difficultyReason: Apply clockwise angle measurement, retaining complete turns and placing the terminal arm for each negative angle.

content.prompt: Draw a diagram representing each angle.

answer.short: A clockwise turn of $150^{\circ}$; terminal arm in the third quadrant.
answer.worked: $-150^{\circ}+360^{\circ}=210^{\circ}$. Draw a clockwise turn of $150^{\circ}$, ending $30^{\circ}$ below the negative $x$-axis.

spec.description: Clockwise angle arc from the positive x-axis to the third-quadrant terminal arm.

answer.short: A clockwise turn of $330^{\circ}$; terminal arm in the first quadrant.
answer.worked: $-330^{\circ}+360^{\circ}=30^{\circ}$. Draw a clockwise turn of $330^{\circ}$, ending $30^{\circ}$ above the positive $x$-axis.

spec.description: Clockwise arc of 330 degrees ending on the first-quadrant terminal arm.

answer.short: Two complete clockwise revolutions; terminal arm on the positive $x$-axis.
answer.worked: $-720^{\circ}=-2\times360^{\circ}$. Draw two complete clockwise turns, ending on the positive $x$-axis.

spec.description: Clockwise two-turn spiral ending towards the positive x-axis.

answer.short: One and a half clockwise revolutions; terminal arm on the negative $x$-axis.
answer.worked: $-540^{\circ}=-360^{\circ}-180^{\circ}$. Draw one complete clockwise turn, then a further clockwise half-turn.

spec.description: Clockwise spiral showing one and a half revolutions.
